UGC NET Exam Faces Scrutiny Over Repeated Questions and Typos

The National Testing Agency (NTA) is facing criticism after 67 questions from the UGC NET English paper were reportedly found to be repeated from previous exams. Typos in the exam paper have also contributed to student dissatisfaction. This situation has led to significant student outrage and calls for accountability.
